Overview
18 holes, played in order from the first tee by the clubhouse.
5,671 m yellow
Par 71
Troon, Scotland
The fly-over stops after every stroke. Tap the yellow button, or press Space or Enter, to hit the next shot. Plan: yellow tees, driver 180 m, 3-wood/hybrid 150 m, 5–6 iron 128 m, 7–8 iron 108 m, PW 88 m, wedge 55 m. . Terrain: Scottish Government LiDAR heights with a course map drawn from OpenStreetMap, relief exaggerated 1.5×. Hole lines follow OpenStreetMap, so routes, hazards and landing spots are approximate.
